title: Application of Eastern Edison Company for authorization and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of (1) the issuance and sale of a new class of cumulative preferred stock in an amount not in excess of $20,000,000 aggregate par value, (2) the issuance and sale of one or more new series of its First Mortgage and Collateral Trust Bonds in an aggregate principal amount not in excess of $75,000,000 and (3) an exemption from the publication provisions of section 15 of Chapter 164 of the General Laws.
